title: Probe evidence overlay
description: One file per client under data/verified/, generated by probe/scripts/collect.ts. Holds the verified-tier Evidence records the probe produced, keyed by capability id, so they can be merged into the client's entry in data/clients.json or read on their own. The Evidence shape is the registry schema's.

registryId.description: The id in data/clients.json, when the client has an entry there.

capabilities.description: Capability id (data/spec-versions.json vocabulary) to the evidence the probe gathered for it.
